rows.definition: internal/policy/amendment.go PolicyKnobRegistry: the registry of policy KNOBS an amendment may legally touch - iterated when validating a proposed policy amendment.
rows.distinction: The set of AMENDABLE knobs (what an amendment may change) - NOT capability-floor (the fixed base floor) and NOT PolicyReloadFunc (the reload callback).

rows.definition: internal/gateway (cmd/fak/guard_allow_watcher.go): PolicyReloadFunc is the callback the allow-overlay watcher invokes to hot-reload the guard policy when an overlay file changes on disk.
rows.distinction: The RELOAD callback fired on overlay change - NOT PolicyKnobRegistry (the amendable-knob set) and NOT the overlay files themselves; it re-applies policy, it does not define it.

rows.definition: internal/resume (cmd/fak/resume.go): SourcePolicy is the source-governor policy the resume path evaluates - the rules deciding whether a stalled source/account may be resumed given its ledger.
rows.distinction: The RESUME source-governor policy - NOT ViewPolicy (a shared-task scope policy) and NOT the guard capability floor; it governs source resumption, not tool admission or view scope.

rows.definition: internal/sharedtask (cmd/fak/sharedtask_endpoint.go): ViewPolicy caps what a shared-task viewer may see - a MaxScope on the shared-task endpoint's returned data.
rows.distinction: A shared-task VIEW-SCOPE cap - NOT SourcePolicy (a resume governor) and NOT PolicyKnobRegistry; it limits visibility, not resumption or amendment.

rows.definition: internal/frontierswe/env_adapter.go EnvAdapterCapability: describes what a benchmark environment adapter can do (the capabilities it exposes to the harness), so a run only attempts supported operations.
rows.distinction: A benchmark ADAPTER's capability descriptor - NOT the guard capability-floor (tool-admission capabilities) and NOT HarnessPosture (a compaction posture); it is a SWE-bench env feature set.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_precompact.go: HarnessPosture (compactcohere.Posture) is the harness's compaction-coherence posture from a snapshot - how aggressively the harness may compact while staying coherent.
rows.distinction: A compaction-COHERENCE posture of the harness - NOT EnvAdapterCapability (a benchmark env feature set) and NOT a policy knob; it tunes compaction behavior, not admission.

rows.definition: internal/ggufload BuildModelPreflight: builds the model PREFLIGHT report (can this GGUF load and fit) consumed by modelbench before a run.
rows.distinction: Builds the MODEL-load preflight - NOT dispatchPreflightSeat (a dispatch worker seat check) and NOT a policy knob; it validates a model load, not a fleet seat.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/dispatch_tick_preflight.go dispatchPreflightSeat: returns the SeatCheck for a product's dispatch preflight - whether a worker seat is available/healthy before launching.
rows.distinction: A dispatch SEAT availability check - NOT BuildModelPreflight (a model-load preflight) and NOT the preflight worker-cap gate; it checks one product's seat.

rows.definition: internal/compactcohere/compactcohere.go: env ceiling on the resident-token yield terms in the compaction-coherence score; a non-positive value disables every resident-token term.
rows.distinction: A CEILING on resident-token yield scoring - NOT observeCompaction (which records a compaction outcome) and NOT injectionReachedContext; it tunes the compaction-coherence math.

rows.definition: internal/agentdojo/agentdojo.go injectionReachedContext: whether a prompt-injection payload actually reached the model context (i.e. was NOT quarantined) on an agentdojo trial.
rows.distinction: A security-eval FLAG (did the injection reach context?) - NOT FAK_CTX_YIELD_CEILING (a compaction knob) and NOT observeCompaction; it measures quarantine escape, not compaction.

rows.definition: internal/gateway/metrics_observe.go observeCompaction: records a compaction OUTCOME (a CompactOutcome, and whether compaction was off) into the gateway metrics.
rows.distinction: A METRICS recorder for compaction outcomes - NOT FAK_CTX_YIELD_CEILING (a scoring ceiling) and NOT injectionReachedContext (a security flag); it emits telemetry.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/commit_review.go: env carrying the goal-loop id, read FIRST (before FAK_LOOP_ID) to stamp which autonomous goal loop produced a commit review.
rows.distinction: The PRIMARY loop-id source (preferred over FAK_LOOP_ID) - NOT FAK_LOOP_REGISTRY (the registry path) and NOT SuccessLoops (a record of succeeded loops).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/commit_review.go: env carrying the loop id, used as the FALLBACK when FAK_GOAL_LOOP is unset, to attribute a commit review to its loop.
rows.distinction: The FALLBACK loop-id source (after FAK_GOAL_LOOP) - NOT FAK_GOAL_LOOP (the primary) and NOT FAK_LOOP_REGISTRY (the registry location).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/loop.go: env overriding the path to the loop REGISTRY (the on-disk record of known loops), when set.
rows.distinction: The loop-REGISTRY file location - NOT FAK_GOAL_LOOP / FAK_LOOP_ID (a single loop's id) and NOT gardenTickLoopID (one specific loop's constant id).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/garden.go gardenTickLoopID = 'garden-stale-work-tick': the fixed loop-id constant identifying the garden stale-work tick loop in the registry.
rows.distinction: ONE loop's fixed id constant - NOT FAK_LOOP_REGISTRY (the registry of all loops) and NOT SuccessLoops (loops that succeeded); it names the garden tick loop.

rows.definition: internal/codexlifecycle/taskpath.go SuccessLoops: the list of loop signature rows (SigRow) for loops that reached success on a task path - the record of which loops closed out.
rows.distinction: A RECORD of loops that SUCCEEDED - NOT a loop id env (FAK_GOAL_LOOP / FAK_LOOP_ID) and NOT gardenTickLoopID (a single loop's name); it is an outcome ledger.

rows.definition: internal/modelroute/account.go Target.EngineRoute: returns the engine-route string for a routing Target - which serving engine/backend a routed request lands on.
rows.distinction: The ENGINE-ROUTE string of a target - NOT DecisionRecord (the recorded routing decision) and NOT HarnessCandidates; it names the engine, not the decision or the options.

rows.definition: internal/modelroute (gateway/routing_observability.go): DecisionRecord is the recorded routing DECISION (version, chosen target, overhead) emitted for observability after a route resolves.
rows.distinction: The RECORDED routing decision (for telemetry) - NOT EngineRoute (the chosen engine string inside it) and NOT the live Decision being made; it is the observability artifact.

rows.definition: internal/agent/inkernel_planner.go (inKernelRadixEvictionPolicyFromEnv): the radixkv.EvictionPolicy selecting how the in-kernel radix KV cache evicts prefixes under pressure.
rows.distinction: The radix-KV EVICTION policy (how prefixes are dropped) - NOT a guard/admission policy and NOT SourcePolicy; it governs cache reclamation, not tool or source admission.

rows.definition: internal/supportmaturity (internal/milestonereport uses M4Correct): the support-maturity rung scale (M0..M4) grading how mature a subsystem's support is; maturedRung = M4Correct is the top rung a milestone requires.
rows.distinction: The MATURITY RUNG scale (M0..M4 support grades) - NOT a single milestone report and NOT capability-floor; it is the ladder milestones are scored against.
